optimized_sql:
SELECT MIN(mc.note) AS production_note,
       MIN(t.title) AS movie_title,
       MIN(t.production_year) AS movie_year
FROM (SELECT id
      FROM company_type
      WHERE kind = 'production companies') AS ct
JOIN (SELECT company_type_id,
             movie_id,
             note
      FROM movie_companies
      WHERE note NOT LIKE '%(as Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Pictures)%'
        AND (note LIKE '%(co-production)%' OR note LIKE '%(presents)%')) AS mc
  ON mc.company_type_id = ct.id
JOIN title AS t
  ON t.id = mc.movie_id
JOIN (SELECT mi_idx.movie_id
      FROM movie_info_idx AS mi_idx
      WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
                    FROM info_type AS it
                    WHERE it.id = mi_idx.info_type_id
                      AND it.info = 'top 250 rank')) AS mi
  ON mi.movie_id = mc.movie_id
